Final head for L1 (fix round 1, cloud session `session_01QSeKYnV6DdKeTL414FFGnp`) · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T04:36Z
Head-sha: `e0555965eb88dc705cd855f39fd804a2e03ff2ba`

- Round 0, head `5dde589a`: same-server `/api/` reads and writes in `app-shell` and the console move from the bare cookie-only `fetch` onto `createAuthenticatedFetch`: 64 calls in 39 source files.
  - A shrink-only vitest ratchet (`sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts`) refuses a new bare cookie-only call outside a listed set of 21 calls in 15 files, each with its reason.
  - The measured case is pinned in `packages-io.bearerSession.test.ts`. A round-0 ablation turned the ratchet and both bearer-only pins red, while the cookie-only control stayed green.
- Fix round 1: CI at `5dde589a` was red on two causes, both from `main` moving (PR #37108's ⌘K palette).
  - `origin/main` merged clean (`3db4a107`).
  - `check:test-source-alias`: four edited `StudioDesignSurface` suites now reach `import('@object-ui/plugin-detail')` through the palette chain. Each gained the prescribed module-top import (`cff1b9d5`).
  - `StudioPaletteGroups.surfaceScope-36900`: its package-list double had no `headers`, so the converted authenticated read threw. The double gained `headers: new Headers()` as in round 0 (`e0555965`). 11/11 pass, and no assertion changed.
- Readings at this head, from the dev:
  - the whole `app-shell` + console suite: 26745 tests passed. The one red file is `ReportNewPage-36692`, which is not in this diff; it is load-sensitive and passed 3 of 3 in isolated reruns.
  - `app-shell` type-check: 69/69.
  - ui `scripts/`: 5131 tests passed.
  - 39 derived gate families, all exit 0, none NOT MEASURED.
- Serial constraint, raised to the seat: `overlap-check` shows textual conflicts with open Studio PRs #37089, #37166, #37168 and #37169 on shared test files, and with `PackageSwitcher.tsx` and `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx` for #37166 and #37169. It merges cleanly with `origin/main`.
- Check-runs at this head: 40 success, 15 skipped, 0 failing or running.
- Size: 160+ files, under the 3000-line threshold. Not governed.
- Handed to the seat session for L1. This zone does not ready or queue the PR before an ACCEPT on this head.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `e0555965eb88dc705cd855f39fd804a2e03ff2ba` · 2026-11-25T04:44Z

- **Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37185`, exit 0, clean):**
  - open, draft, base `main`;
  - first line `Fixes #37080`, and no keyword binds another card;
  - no `content/docs/releases/` path, and no `+0/-0` file.
- **Size:** +1106/-290 = 1,396 lines in 161 files. That is under 3,000, so it is not Tier H by size. The tier is L,
  per the claim correction.
- **Governed paths:** none. No `.github/workflows`, `.claude`, `skills/`, `docs/adr` or `AGENTS.md`.
- **Surface:**
  - everything is under `ui/packages/app-shell/src`, `ui/apps/console/src` and `.changeset/`;
  - the claim's three fenced files (`AiChatPage.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`) are
    not edited.
- **Done-when 1** (same-server `/api/` calls go through `createAuthenticatedFetch`, built per call, with
  `credentials: 'include'` kept):
  - read in the source diff: 64 calls in 39 files, each init unchanged;
  - no new helper, and no `export` line touched.
  - Red on revert:
    - the ratchet flags any reverted direct call, `??` fallback or marketplace `serverFetch` call;
    - `packages-io.bearerSession.test.ts` pins the measured `readPackagesPayload` under a bearer-only server, with a
      cookie-only control;
    - the round-0 ablation in the PR body shows both red.
  - One exception: N1.
- **Done-when 2** (one enumeration pin):
  - `sameServerFetch.bearer.ratchet.test.ts` is a test, not a CI gate, as the claim says;
  - it is parsed by the TS parser over both trees and is shrink-only;
  - it has an exactness case and a 13-case detector battery.
  - The allow-list is 21 calls in 15 files, read as stated. No verdict on any row; it stays as it is.
- **Test doubles:**
  - I spot-read the moved doubles: `headers: new Headers()`, re-pointed auth mocks, and the reads switched to
    `Headers`. No assertion is weakened.
  - Round 1 is test-side only: 4 module-top `@object-ui/plugin-detail` imports and the headers on the
    `surfaceScope-36900` double.
- **i18n vs `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`:**
  - the PR diff has 0 paths under `ui/packages/i18n`, and 0 changed `t(` / `tFormat(` lines;
  - no released key is removed or renamed.
- **Published exports and types:**
  - `@object-ui/console` (published) changes transport only, in 3 files;
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` is private;
  - no barrel or `packages/spec` change, so no contract face.
- **Declarations:**
  - `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are correct, in the PR body and both changeset bodies;
  - `Skills-docs` is not owed.
- **Changesets:**
  - one per moved package: console patch and app-shell patch;
  - I checked them sentence by sentence against the diff;
  - the titles are in user terms.
  - Nits: N3.
- **维护者速读:** 4 Chinese business lines with no code names. Each claim matches the diff: the package list, chat
  lists, suggested bindings, commit history and draft panel; cookie sessions unchanged; server unchanged; no
  maintainer action.
- **Check-runs at head:**
  - 55 in all: 40 success, 15 skipped (expected), 0 failed, 0 pending;
  - Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Test UI (aggregate and 9 planned shards), Build & E2E UI
    and Live E2E UI all succeeded.
- **K = 10:** merge base `3b4f0b98`, `origin/main` `93bd4595`.
- **Overlap (`git merge-tree` against each head):**
  - #37089 has merged, so it is now main.
    - It conflicts in `StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708` and `readOnlyPosture-12453`.test.tsx. Both sides add the
      same `import '@object-ui/plugin-detail'`; only the comment differs. Textual-trivial.
  - #37166:
    - modify/delete on `StudioRoute.searchPalette-11863`, four `BuilderLanding.*` tests and
      `fetchInstalledPackageRow-7881`. Take the deletion: textual-trivial.
    - `PackageSwitcher.tsx`: #37166 deletes the converted `fetchInstalledPackageRow`. Take the deletion and drop the
      unused `authFetch`: textual, mechanical.
    - `notFound-26708`: comment only, textual-trivial.
    - Semantic, with no marker: N2.
  - #37168: `StudioDesignSurface` `entryReadsOnce-11797`, `itemDraftLine-12725`, `notFound-26708` and
    `readOnlyPosture-12453`. The same import is on both sides and only the comment differs. Textual-trivial.
  - #37169:
    - `CommandPalette.studioScope-11863`: comment only, textual-trivial.
    - `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx`: import-block adjacency. Keep both import sets and the `authFetch` call. Textual-trivial,
      and the ratchet reds a bare call left behind.
- S1 (should-fix) — the PR is `mergeable_state: dirty` against current main (#37089 landed after the round-1 merge).
  - Fix in a patch round: merge `origin/main` and keep one comment in the two conflicting test headers.
  - Main's other 9 commits since `3b4f0b98` add no `credentials: 'include'` call and no header-less double in the
    two trees, so I expect a comment-only merge.
  - Re-read the merge commit only, and check the check-runs at the new head before ready or queue.
- N1 — the ratchet does not follow the `flowDraftChecks.ts` alias.
  - `const doFetch = opts.fetchImpl ?? createAuthenticatedFetch()` is followed by a `doFetch(…)` call, and the
    ratchet does not see through that alias.
  - `DraftChangesPanel.flowChecks-34818` now reads through `new Headers(…)`, so it is green either way.
  - That one conversion is therefore not red on revert. The card's enumerated spelling (an inline
    `fetch('/api/…', {credentials})`) is still covered.
- N2 — #37166 adds `PackageCustomizationsPanel.test.tsx`, which doubles the customizations read with a header-less
  Response.
  - The converted `packageCustomizations-io.ts` reads `response.headers`, so the test throws once both PRs land.
  - Whichever lands second adds `headers: new Headers()` to that double. Worth a line to #37166's seat.
- N3 — the changeset wording.
  - The app-shell body's list omits a few converted doors: flow clone, permission-set clone, page preview, the
    no-access state and the design-mode locale list.
  - "as every other console request does" is slightly broad, since 21 listed calls stay bare by design.
  - The body also leans on implementation names. It is not wrong; tighten it if a round is open anyway.
- N4 — the `AiChatPage.tsx` row's reason ("an open pull request edits this file") is stale.
  - #37123 merged 2026-11-25T00:33:13Z, before the merge base, and the call is still bare.
  - The fence has lifted. Convert in a follow-up after landing; no allow-list edit in this PR.
